zh: 操作菜单支持整行悬停高亮，底部快捷键提示颜色统一。
引导窗口与主窗口等高，上下对齐。
补齐打开磁盘权限设置后的退出重启衔接。
更多操作采用更紧凑的蓝灰毛玻璃样式，优化选中效果与滚动条。
菜单栏使用单色狐狸图标；关闭引导后，重新启动保持关闭，可从菜单再次查看。
支持从 GitHub 自动检查更新，并在应用内下载、校验与重启安装。
降低引导插图解码内存，复用菜单行，减少重复引导刷新和预览清理。
重新设计带应用图标的毛玻璃更新窗口，明确跳过、自动检查和立即安装操作。
修复输入时引导反复切换；图标异步加载，滚动时减少预览及后台索引竞争。
应用网格显示真实应用图标；菜单栏菜单补齐功能图标与快捷键。
设置窗口采用统一毛玻璃；筛选项左对齐，修复滚动条跟随位置与预览区重叠。
自动更新开关靠右，检查更新位于说明下方；顶部菜单开机启动改用胶囊开关。
恢复原生响应式滚动，按可见区域计算网格布局，滑动时延后图标加载并减少重复绘制。
宫格使用对应的彩色文件类型图标，图片预览加速，已加载缩略图在滚动与收藏操作后保持稳定。
操作菜单移除搜索框，增加适配深浅色的柔和阴影，保留键盘选择与执行。
en: Full-row action hover feedback and consistent footer shortcut styling.
The side guide matches the main window height and alignment.
One-shot relaunch handling after opening Full Disk Access settings.
A compact blue-gray frosted actions menu with refined selection and transient scrolling.
A monochrome fox in the menu bar; dismissed guidance stays closed across launches.
Automatic update checks via GitHub, with verified in-app download and restart installation.
Smaller decoded guide artwork, reusable action rows, and fewer redundant UI updates.
A frosted update window with the app icon and clear skip, automatic-check and install controls.
Guide pages remain stable while typing; asynchronous icons and less preview/indexing work while scrolling.
Real application icons in the grid, plus icon-and-label menu bar commands.
Unified frosted settings, aligned filters, accurate thin scrollbars and separated preview edges.
Right-aligned update switch, a check button below its description, and a native Launch at Login menu switch.
Restored native responsive scrolling, viewport-bounded grid layout, deferred icons during gestures and less repeated painting.
Matching full-color file icons in the grid, faster image previews and stable cached thumbnails across scrolling and favorites.
A simpler actions menu without a search field, with adaptive soft shadows and keyboard navigation.
